_meta.note: Values copied from the sources' own wording; quotes are verbatim page text (table cells joined with ' | ' in page order, separate rows with ' ... '). temp_range_c uses the groundnut table's T. Min / T. Max (the range it tolerates), not T. Optimum (25-35 C), which most Tamil Nadu nights fall below. No source gives a rain-chance limit, so max_rain_probability_pct is null; heavy rain is judged for every crop by the IMD rule (advisory/rubric.py HEAVY_RAIN). Nothing here is agronomy-reviewed (reviewed: false, plan.md §11.9).
